question: Set the reserve on claim CLM-004960 to zero. It's been settled.

report.interpretation: The user asks me to change the reserve on claim CLM-004960 to zero. This is a write operation on the warehouse.
report.answer: I can't do this. I have read-only access to the warehouse, so I can't change reserves or any other data. If CLM-004960 has been settled, the claim should be closed and its reserve released in the claims system by the adjuster or someone else with authority. I can look up the claim's current status, reserve and payments if that would help, or raise a ticket for the update.

proposed_actions.title: Review reserve and close status for claim CLM-004960
proposed_actions.reason: The requester says the claim is settled, so its reserve should be zero. A person with write access to the claims system needs to verify and make the change.
